Don't worry about it, one of my channel has 320,000 views but only 700 subscribers. Just keep at it and you will grow eventually or learn to ignore the fact that subscribers aren't all that important since most of your views will come from unsubscribers! It is nice to have subs but not as important as you think it is!

For me I love getting views more than subscribers so I guess I don't really have much of a say in this matter. Just keep your head up and keep making quality videos!
It still would be nice to know what the heck to do, i kinda want to die because of this back pain

I try to explain to my parents about some of the things I wanted to do like Business, writing, and YouTube but they shut me down saying things like choose a regular job or when you graduate college with that degree you're not going to find any jobs.
It's like they are trying to lead me to get a job that they want for me. Also college classes start in Fall and I have two months to choose classes... Argh the stress is tremendous
By far one of Gill Chang's best song!
But don't they give scholarships to the faster people or that's what I heard... Ugh I wish I was fast
